captions.detailed: A 3D-printable general-purpose keyed knob. It features a wide, slightly tapered cylindrical base with a smooth, rounded fillet at the very bottom. Protruding from the flat top of this base is a narrower cylindrical shaft containing a D-shaped hollow inner bore and a rectangular key tab running vertically along its outer side.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric keyed knob in OpenSCAD with a customizable rounded base and a keyed shaft. The user should be able to adjust parameters such as the fillet radius, base height, minimum and maximum base radii, shaft height, inner/outer shaft radii, and key tab dimensions.
captions.factory: The script uses a union of three main parts: a base, a shaft, and an external key tab. The base is created by using the hull() operator on a rotate_extrude() circle (to form the rounded fillet) and a tapered cylinder(). The shaft is built from a cylinder() from which a smaller cylinder and a cutting cube are subtracted to form a D-shaped inner bore. Finally, a small cube is translated and joined to the side of the shaft to act as the alignment key.
